Flip function panics with index out of range on empty bitmap

#### Description

The Flip function causes a runtime panic when called on an empty bitmap. The panic occurs with "index out of range [-1]" error.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "github.com/RoaringBitmap/roaring/v2/roaring64"
)

func main() {
    rb := roaring64.NewBitmap()
    // This will panic
    result := roaring64.Flip(rb, 0, 10)
    println(result.GetCardinality())
}
```

The panic occurs when trying to flip a range on an empty bitmap. Expected behavior would be to return a new bitmap with the flipped range set.
